items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Also had a boy in the band named Herbert "Peanuts" Holland. Peanuts played with Trent's band.

ctx.x: My father worked on this job a few years, and something happened on the job and he quit the job. And we had a rough going there for a while. So, finally my father was hired as a janitor at the Post Office. And I can remember him saying the salary was $500.00 a year. And when payday would come, my father would have to wait sometimes four, and five, and six, and sometimes a week and a half or two weeks before he would get his check. That's the way the government operated back in those days. And that worked a…

We came up in the early years seeming that we had plenty of food to eat, and my father bought us plenty of clothes and things like that. And then the third boy came along. My brother Herbert came along. And in the meantime things began to get a little tough for us.

Before I go into that phase of my early life, I would like to mention the fact that when I was six or seven years old at one of those shows, I can remember it was a big circus. And they had a big brass band, and a big wagon drawn by horses. And the band was playing, and the elephants were marching. You know, you could see the wild animals in the cages of the wagons.
